item.title: Rhine Low Water: Kaub Falls to 13 cm
item.description:

Also: Nordic parcel peak preparations at PostNord and Bring, a freight fraud report on compromised communications, AI-generated supplier records and audits, and Germany's plan to route truck-toll revenue to Autobahn GmbH. Quick hits on Maersk's signal of more ship orders and Epiroc buying Aramine.

item.title: The Signal and the Noise by Silver: Book Summary
item.description:
The Signal and the Noise by Nate Silver (2012) explains why most forecasts fail and what the few good forecasters do differently. For planners it makes the case for ranges over single numbers, testing models on data they never saw, measuring calibration and updating as facts change. For demand planners, S&OP leads and anyone who builds forecasting models.

item.title: Book of the week: The Goal, Goldratt and Cox
item.description:
This week's book is The Goal by Eliyahu M. Goldratt and Jeff Cox, the 1984 business novel that introduced the Theory of Constraints. Its main idea: find the bottleneck, protect it and pace everything else to it, because an hour lost there is lost for the whole system. For planners, plant managers and network designers.
